gate_type: ACCELERATED IMPLEMENTATION GATE — Align Observation / Event / Alarm Production Contracts (G3)
objective: Implement the smallest production alignment so Runtime Truth -> immutable Observation/Event facts -> projections holds and Alarm is a specialization/category of Event, WITHOUT creating duplicate mutable truth, WITHOUT turning monitoring/UI into authority, and WITHOUT capability/readiness, coordinator/ports, UI, semantic binding, run-control, historian, or alarm-workflow work. Add a typed immutable platform Event fact (event_type/category/identity/occurrence time/source/severity-status/payload/G2 provenance reference as appropriate); represent Alarm as an Event specialization/category (every emitted alarm fact is also an Event fact) with mutable alarm condition/state kept as a DERIVED projection only; adapt the EventStore skeleton to append-style typed immutable Event facts (no mutation/deletion, deterministic read order, no historian); align AlarmManager so it can emit immutable alarm Event facts on activation/clear transitions while preserving existing industrial_event SignalValue output and AlarmState as derived current-state projection; add a minimal backward-compatible Observation context/provenance seam that carries G1/G2 identity only when explicitly supplied (never fabricates for legacy callers); preserve existing ObservationEnvelope/ObservationService semantics and G2 provenance seam (no second provenance model).
explicit_non_objectives: No G4 composition graph / coordinator / typed ports
No G6 hierarchical UI / frontend changes
No G7 run/scenario control or replay
No G9 PIM semantic binding / canonical resolver
No redesign of discrete ScheduledEvent or maintenance event_generator
No change to runtime/domain mutable truth authority
forbidden_actions: Implement G4+ (capability/readiness, coordinator/ports, ASSY federation, UI, run-control, PIM binding, SH-WTP runtime)
Fabricate G1/G2 identity or PIM canonical ids for legacy callers
Make Observation or Event a mutable runtime authority
Implement historian/database retention or alarm workflow/notification
Change plant-control semantics / alarm thresholds / domain behavior
Delete or reduce existing tests silently
stop_conditions: Existing accepted observation semantics materially conflict with ARCH-03
Alarm cannot be modeled as Event specialization without a breaking domain contract
Provenance alignment requires changing accepted G2 authority
Preserving ASSY/continuous behavior requires domain runtime rewrite

acceptance_criteria.description: One typed immutable Event fact model exists
Alarm is represented as Event specialization/category
Mutable alarm condition/state is derived projection only (does not mutate historical facts)
Event storage is append-style typed facts, not mutable dict authority
Runtime state remains sole mutable execution truth
Observation pipeline remains compatible with a non-fabricating G1/G2 context seam
G2 provenance seam reused, no second provenance model
Mandatory regressions pass or baseline anomalies honestly evidenced
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed
